excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, short blonde hair, lightly tanned skin. Wears a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, white skirt and light blue pumps.
excavation_context.stage: Air-Scribing Fine Sandstone Matrix in a Museum Lab

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_2 works meticulously at her indoor laboratory workbench under bright hood lights, steering a pneumatic air-scribe across a block of hard tan sandstone matrix. Her precise work clears away the stone to isolate the sharp, serrated teeth of an Allosaurus maxilla. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
